summary: Trillion Energy International Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing that the British Columbia Securities Commission granted a management cease trade order (MCTO) in connection with delays in its annual financial filings for the year ended December 31, 2025. The MCTO restricts trading by certain insiders but does not affect other shareholders. The company expects to file by May 8, 2026, citing a transition to a new reserves evaluator. No change of control, merger, tender offer, or other special situation is described; this is a routine disclosure of a regulatory order related to late filings.
